description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Gemstone Array three times by paying {6}, putting three charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array three times by removing three charge counters from it, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 8 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.
